parameters.content:
WF7 - Error Handler

After import:
1. 'Append Errors': pick your service-account credential.
2. 'Get Settings': choose 'WF0 - Get Settings'.
3. 'Email Operator': pick your Gmail SMTP credential.
4. Activate.
5. In WF1, WF2, WF3, WF5, WF6 and WF8: Settings (three dots) > Error workflow > choose 'WF7 - Error Handler'.
